leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a singly linked list data structure with nodes containing value and next pointer properties
Initialize two pointers to traverse the linked list for locating the target node from the end
Manipulate pointer positions to maintain a gap that isolates the nth node from the end
Apply pointer adjustments to remove the target node by updating the previous node's next reference
Configure edge case handling for scenarios such as removing the head node or invalid positions
Integrate the removal logic into a complete function that returns the modified linked list head
